notes.title: Large patch incoming.
notes.content:
We've tweaked Stage 2 - Sewer Control Room, to be slightly easier to complete by removing some of the zombies from the Challenging difficulty level.

All levels have had a new light bake completed to adjust for some darker spots than intended.

Spikes & Bars and Paul's Murder town have been slightly adjusted for timing.

Illiria's Pet has been slightly adjusted to be less of a puzzle and more of a chase.

Murder forest has been slightly adjusted with fewer killers to make it more completeable.
